lines.zh: 我在浅滩上挪动，甲壳擦着石底。
lines.en: I shift across the shallows, shell scraping stone.
Seawater drips off me.
I crawl up onto the shore, step by step.

lines.zh: 背上长出的东西随着我一起动。
lines.en: The growths on my back move with me.

lines.zh: 我用前肢撑地，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I prop on my forelimbs and haul forward.
I leave a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸线走，眼睛盯着陆上。
lines.en: I follow the shoreline, eyes on the land.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，螃蟹都躲开了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the crabs scatter.
I weave between the rocks.

lines.zh: 我不着急，海水在我体内涨。
lines.en: I am not hurried; the sea rises inside me.
My tendrils probe ahead.

lines.zh: 我朝有动静的方向移动。
lines.en: I move toward the noise.

lines.zh: 潮水推我一段，我自己走一段。
lines.en: The tide pushes me, then I walk on my own.

lines.zh: 我把一只铁傀儡的影子记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the shadow of an iron golem.
Seaweed clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙滩，慢慢向上爬。
lines.en: I climb slowly up the beach.

lines.zh: 我伏在浅水里，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie in the shallows without moving.
Water runs between the plates of my shell.
I listen for the tide.
The light under my shell flickers and dims.

lines.zh: 一点盐味就够我安静下来。
lines.en: A trace of salt is enough to quiet me.
I flatten my body.

lines.zh: 甲壳上有东西在慢慢长。
lines.en: Something grows slowly on my shell.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，水从鳃里过。
lines.en: I breathe, and water passes through my gills.
I lie still, indistinguishable from rock.

lines.zh: 我又往陆地这边挤了一点。
lines.en: I press a little farther onto land.

lines.zh: 水顺着我的甲缝滴回海里。
lines.en: Water drips from my seams back into the sea.
I wait for a heavier tide.

lines.zh: 周围的海嗣气味越来越重。
lines.en: The smell of kin grows stronger around me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地盯着海面。
lines.en: I stare at the sea without blinking.
I watch you from under the water.
You stand at the water's edge, too close.
I have more than two eyes.
Everything on land should come down.

lines.zh: 你听见我壳里的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear what moves inside my shell?
I rise slowly above the surface.

lines.zh: 你的皮肤干，我闻不到海。
lines.en: Your skin is dry; I smell no sea on it.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，水珠掉下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and water drips off.

lines.zh: 我把你的步幅换算好了。
lines.en: I've worked out the length of your stride.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水里，这样就很好。
lines.en: You on land, me in water; that is fine.
I give a muffled sound; my shell cracks.
I retract into my shell, then extend again.
Brine seeps from the wound.
I retreat into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，减少目标。
lines.en: I flatten to make a smaller target.
I sway, then steady.
My tendrils curl up.
That only made me hungrier.
I wash the wound in the water.
I will not withdraw.
Will what you hold sink?
There is more food in the sea than that.
I extend a tendril, then withdraw it.
That smell is wrong.
I do not eat what comes from land.
The tide understands me better than your hand.
I come close only to smell.
The water is withdrawing from your feet.
I am not hungry, but I want to eat.
It fell in the water; I took it.
I bump you and brine splashes up.

lines.zh: 湿滑的壳贴着你滑过去。
lines.en: My wet shell slides against you.
I pull back, leaving a wet mark.
You lose balance, and I pass by.
My weight bends you over.
Two wet shadows overlap.
I shove you backward.
A few shell fragments fall off me.
That blow carried the strength of the sea.
My shell scrapes past you, heading for water.
The tide carries the scent of many kin.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，壳互相摩擦。
lines.en: We press together, shells grinding.
There will only be more of us.
We gather under the water.
I make a low sound.
New things are growing.
We need no reason.
Somewhere in the tide, kin answer me.
A layer of foam rises on the water.
The tide goes out and we scatter.
I curl a tendril around it.
What falls in the water belongs to the sea.
It slips around in my grip.

lines.zh: 海晶碎块卡进我的甲缝。
lines.en: A shard of prismarine wedges into my seam.
Prismarine shards; I want those.
I fish it out and look.
This will rust.
I swallow it into my body.
More things cling to my shell now.
This crystal belongs to my shell now.
You carry the heat of a living thing.
Once I smell you, I have you.
My head turns toward you.
The tide is rising.

lines.zh: 我伏低身体，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I flatten and ready a spring.

lines.zh: 陆地上的东西，一个都留不下。
lines.en: Nothing on land will remain.
I have marked you first.
I lift my forelimbs.
My shell clacks.
It makes no difference which way you run.

lines.zh: 我的湿痕一直连到你脚跟。
lines.en: My wet trail runs all the way to your heels.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我离你更近了。
lines.en: When you look back, I am closer.
My wet trail runs all the way to you.

lines.zh: 你跑到干地上，我还是跟。
lines.en: Run onto dry ground; I still follow.
My tendrils look for an angle.
You stepped in a puddle.
The sea surges behind you.
I make no sound; I only close in.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你露出的后颈。
lines.en: I never take my eyes off your bare neck.
This whole shore is mine.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，甲壳边缘划开皮。
lines.en: I ram you and my shell edge opens flesh.
A tendril wraps your ankle.
A limb slaps your chest.
Brine pours into your wound.
I press my weight down on you.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了整条前肢。
lines.en: That one used my whole forelimb.
The blow lays you out on the sand.
My shell grinds over your armor.
I bite and taste iron.
I withdraw to the water and wait.
The tide withdraws and leaves me on the shore.
I crawl out of the surf.
This shell is bigger than the one before.
The smell of kin arrives first.

lines.zh: 我从浪里浮上来，带着光。
lines.en: I rise out of the waves, trailing light.

lines.zh: 我爬上岸时，沙子湿了一片。
lines.en: The sand darkens where I climb out.
I have been sent.
One more shell among the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的第一批触须伸出来。
lines.en: My first tendrils extend.
The sea calms and I wait.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的壳，我疼得缩起来。
lines.en: Fire dries my shell and I curl up in pain.

lines.zh: 我砸在礁石上，壳磕掉一角。
lines.en: I crash onto the rocks and chip my shell.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这次水太多了。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet this is too much of it.
The blast throws me up onto the shore.
An arrow lodges between my plates.
Spell-light burns a hole in my shell.

lines.zh: 离海太久，我的壳在变干。
lines.en: Too long from the sea and my shell dries.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，盐分都在响。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and the salt crackles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我窒息了。
lines.en: No water in the void; I am suffocating.
